title: cargo fetch
description: Download the dependencies of a Cargo project

toolchain.description: Rustup toolchain, run as `cargo +<toolchain>`. Without it the project's rust-toolchain.toml applies.

manifestPath.description: Path to Cargo.toml; {projectRoot} and {workspaceRoot} are replaced.

locked.description: Require Cargo.lock to be up to date (--locked).

frozen.description: Require Cargo.lock and the cache to be up to date, no network (--frozen).

args.description: Extra arguments passed to the cargo subcommand.

env.description: Environment variables for the cargo process.
